name: Takada Ryouko
source:
[url=/c88598]Takagi Kaede[/url]'s mother, she is concerned that her daughter is not on good terms with her father.
She loves both her husband and her daughter properly.
Ryouko's life had no particularly high ups and downs, so it can be said had lived an ordinary life.
